query:
SELECT
                p.id AS "id!",
                p.name AS "name!"
            FROM playlists p
            LEFT JOIN track_plays tp
                ON tp.context_playlist_id = p.id AND tp.user_id = $1
            WHERE p.user_id = $1
            GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.updated_at
            ORDER BY GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(tp.played_at), p.updated_at), p.updated_at) DESC
            LIMIT $2
